entries.title: Teaching the practised thief
entries.literal_meaning: Teaching an old hand at theft how to steal!
entries.explanation: The dictionary places this exclamation under a thief practised in the activity, separately from an elderly thief. Its joke makes the lesson unnecessary because the learner already knows the craft. Our everyday application questions instruction offered without first finding out what someone knows; it neither praises theft nor says experienced people cannot learn.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନର ଏହି ଅର୍ଥରେ ଚୋରଟି ଚୋରିରେ ପାରଙ୍ଗମ; କେବଳ ବୟସରେ ବୁଢ଼ା ନୁହେଁ। ଯିଏ କାମଟି ଆଗରୁ ଜାଣେ, ତାକୁ ସେହି କାମ ଶିଖାଇବାରେ କଥାର ମଜା। ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ ଶିଖାଇବା ଆଗରୁ ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କେତେ ଜାଣନ୍ତି, ତାହା ବୁଝିବା ଦରକାର। ଏହା ଚୋରିର ପ୍ରଶଂସା ବା ଅଭିଜ୍ଞ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଆଉ ଶିଖିବାର ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ରାୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: An unnecessary lesson becomes the joke; our application asks about prior experience.
entries.odia_summary: ଆଗରୁ ଜାଣିଥିବା କାମ ଶିଖାଇବାକୁ ନେଇ ମଜା; ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ ପୂର୍ବ ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତାକୁ ଜାଣିବା ଜରୁରୀ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ନୂଆ ସହକର୍ମୀ ଫାଇଲ ସଜାଇବା ଶିଖାଇବାକୁ ଯାଉଥିଲେ। ରୀତା କହିଲେ, “ଏହି ପଦ୍ଧତିଟା ମୁଁ ତିଆରି କରିଥିଲି; ତୁମ ପାଖରେ କିଛି ନୂଆ ଉପାୟ ଅଛି କି?” / A colleague begins explaining a filing method to its creator, who remains open to improvements. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The saying accompanies sense1, proficiency through practice. Sense2 separately describes an elderly thief. Neither establishes a real offender or an age-group trait.

entries.title: Burning without fire
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional reading: Whoever has a grown daughter at home burns in body without fire.
entries.explanation: The line makes a grown daughter’s presence the occasion for burning without flame. It does not state marriage, dowry, a cause of distress or an actual injury. Our critical response refuses to turn that charged comparison into a verdict that daughters are burdens. Asking whose worry is being voiced leaves the young woman’s own perspective open.
entries.meaning_odia: ବଢ଼ିଲା ଝିଅ ଘରେ ଥିବା ସହିତ ନିଆଁ ବିନା ଦେହ ପୋଡ଼ିବାର ତୀବ୍ର ଛବି ଯୋଡ଼ାଯାଇଛି। ଏଠି ବିବାହ, ଯୌତୁକ, ଦୁଃଖର କାରଣ ବା ପ୍ରକୃତ ଆଘାତ କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ପାଠ ଏହାକୁ ଝିଅମାନେ ବୋଝ ବୋଲି ରାୟ କରେନାହିଁ। କାହାର ଚିନ୍ତା ଏଠି କୁହାଯାଉଛି ବୋଲି ପଚାରିଲେ ଝିଅଟିର ନିଜ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିଭଙ୍ଗୀ ପାଇଁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଜାଗା ରହେ। ଦେହଟି କାହାର, ଉତ୍ସ ତାହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରେନାହିଁ; ଏହି ପାଠ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ, ନିଶ୍ଚିତ ଅର୍ଥ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our critical response questions the burden implied by the fireless-burning image.
entries.odia_summary: ନିଆଁ ବିନା ପୋଡ଼ିବାର ଛବିରେ ଥିବା ବୋଝର ଇଙ୍ଗିତକୁ ଆମ ପାଠ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପାଠଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଏଠି କାହାର ଚିନ୍ତା?” ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ କହିଲେ, “ଝିଅଟି ନିଜେ କଣ କହିବ, ସେଥି ବି ଶୁଣିବା ଦରକାର।” / Readers ask whose anxiety the line expresses and leave room for the daughter’s voice. Their discussion is invented, not a collected traditional explanation.
entries.cultural_context: The dictionary defines a daughter who has reached puberty. The pronoun’s bodily subject is not further explained; the literal reading remains provisional. No present-day family or community trait is established.
